concerns.text: Plan task T028 (write per-molecule/property JSON records conforming to prediction.schema.yaml into data/derived/predictions/) has NO matching task: it appears in neither the completed list nor T101–T107, and T106's artifact inventory omits data/derived/predictions/. An implementer following tasks.md cannot satisfy this plan element or the prediction.schema.yaml contract.

Plan task T011.6 (Reference-Validator run producing data/derived/verification_log.txt) is not claimed as completed anywhere in tasks.md and is absent from T106's inventory. Either mark it completed with its artifact or add a task; currently the plan element has no coverage.

The data model's flow step 5 promises 'rf_residuals.png' alongside rf_predictions.csv, but no task (completed or new) produces an RF residual plot, and T106's inventory does not list it. The spec Data Model output 'residual plots' is only half covered (baseline side via T101).

T105's dependency cites 'completed T030.2/T009 artifacts' but no T009 exists in plan.md or tasks.md — stale/dangling task reference. Point at the actual artifact (e.g. data/derived/lna_index.csv from T030.2) instead.

T101 claims 'baseline_test_predictions.csv from completed T014.5 (already present)', but plan T014.5's deliverable is baseline_residuals.png (the rejected artifact), and plan T014c writes baseline_predictions.csv — the referenced filename/task pairing does not exist in the plan, leaving T101's input dependency unverifiable.
